name: AnalystOS
description: Reads a source document and returns a report in which every figure is a verified quote or an independently recomputed calculation.

roles.name: analysis
roles.purpose: Reads one source document and drafts a cited report from verified facts only.
roles.measure: Reports delivered at the written tier, with both quality gates passed, as a share of reports delivered

roles.name: verification
roles.purpose: Recomputes every calculation and refuses any figure it cannot prove against the source.
roles.measure: Facts refused for failing verification, as a share of facts proposed

roles.name: evidence
roles.purpose: Seals each delivered report so a stranger can re-verify it offline.
roles.measure: Delivered reports whose seal re-verifies offline, as a share of reports delivered
